reviews.title: SCAMMED
reviews.text:
Misleading pricing and a terrible cancellation experience. The app claimed a free trial and then $10 after for the next week, but instead I got hit with a full-month charge (~$30). There was no clear notice that I’d be billed for an entire month, and I couldn’t find a real option to cancel inside the app.
Now the charge is still pending, which means I have to wait for it to fully go through just to dispute it with my bank. That’s time, stress, and money tied up for no reason. I feel tricked, and I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone.

reviews.title: Only works with in app purchases
reviews.text: I downloaded this app because I needed to compress a few photos for an email. I got charged a dollar even though it didn’t say it was going to charge me . Then come to find out you have to pay a monthly subscription service in order to be able to actually download anything. This was the biggest waste of one dollar I could’ve ever imagined. Save your time and don’t download this.

reviews.title: Predatory App
reviews.text: I needed to submit some college scratch work, so I googled a pdf scanner, as the professor had requested the photos as a pdf file. As I googled, I unfortunately clicked on the first sponsored result, which was this app. Advertised as “free”, I gritted my teeth and paid the $0.49 cent 7 day free trial because I’d already wasted 7 minutes trying to get this godforsaken app to work. After that “free trial” which cost half a dollar, it’s $9.99 a week. A week. A WEEK!!! That’s outright predatory & outrageous. Canceled the subscription within 12 minutes of having the app. Here’s your review you wanted so badly! Sorry to the review people who have to read this.

reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text: The thing I click said 49p for the first payment and they charged me £9.99. Never using this again after.

reviews.title: No way to cancel
reviews.text: The app is difficult to use. No way of deleting the scanned pages that you don’t need. Tried cancelling the subscription and there is no option for it in the app. Emailed customer service and was told they do not have any control over managing the subscription on my behalf. They referred me back to the app. Feel predatory. Thinking about disputing the charges with my CC.

reviews.title: Slow
reviews.text: I had to scan 14 pages of my test that I did to upload it to my uni site I had 15 minutes to do so and the scanner app took forever to compile each page I ended up handing it in late luckily my professor has given me a pass but this app almost cost me marks on an important exam

reviews.title: Be up don’t about your charges
reviews.text: I was looking for an app that could simply change files in my phone to PDFs. This seemed like an app that could do it simply and easily until I got to the end of changing my JPEG to a PDF. Instead of telling me upfront that it would cost me a minimal daily charge upfront for a trial, I I would also have to agree to pay a $9.99 charge to continue using the app. I think this is deceptive and annoying to somebody. That’s just trying to see if something works.

reviews.title: Useful, but very difficult to cancel
reviews.text: I just needed one scan. I paid the ¢50 trial for one week and immediately tried to cancel the subscription when I was done. I’ve sent several messages, and no one is responding to help me cancel the subscription. This seems so deceitful. Are you going to wait to charge me 10 or 20 dollars before you get back to me?

reviews.title: Weekly $10 charge, NO REFUND
reviews.text:
I’d give it a 4/5 stars for its usefulness, but then it charges you $10 for more than like 3 uses, so you MUST spend the $10 to use it, and then they charge you for it, WEEKLY. I’ve never spent that kind of money on an app… $40 a month, and charged WEEKLY?? very nasty work, and they won’t give me a refund. I don’t mind using it and paying the $10 fee, whatever, I’ll pay it…. But to take advantage of the fact that most people will only use it once, forget about it, then charge them for it WEEKLY, until they eventually start realizing what’s going on, is WRONG. 

And from the developers, I know you’re gonna respond to this and say you’re so sorry and to contact your team to resolve this issue and all that, but how about you contact ME, or just accept my REFUND REQUESTS. That is how you can help resolve this issue!! 😀

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: The app provides no way to cancel your subscription to the pro version which is required to do most actions. They have a ‘manage subscription option under account which takes you to a website that also does not provide any way to cancel the subscription. Making it difficult or impossible to cancel any subscription is illegal. If I could give zero stars , I would.

reviews.title: Scanner? More like Scammer
reviews.text: Or at least they tried being slick smh terrible business practice in my opinion. Literally had me scan 5 pages touch them up with all the different options they have then when you finally finish and it says ready and how would you like to share pdf, text file, they had like 5 or 6 different options but each one I tried would open up a page saying “1 week trial enabled for 3.99” and when you say no thanks it’s back to the share page again. Not cool at all but there is a work around as long as you have a smart phone lol

reviews.title: Not free and crashes a lot
reviews.text:
The app crashed twice while I was trying to scan a doc and doesn’t let you actually save anything until you sign up for a subscription - you only find this out after you’ve finished scanning, despite it being advertised as free.
Bit of a scam, won’t use again.

reviews.title: Another free app that you Pay
reviews.text: I have to say this is getting old and I wish Apple would do something about it. If you have to pay to get the service on an app that’s fine but say it up front. People are tired of downloading app, answering a bunch of questions, and then finding out you have to pay. This app is a prime example. Promises to take a pic and turn it into a Word document which it will do.. after you pay.

reviews.title: Free download
reviews.text: This is misleading. A 7 day trial costs only a little but by then it’s too late as your bank details are in the system.

reviews.title: PDF to JPG
reviews.text: Downloaded to convert PDF to JPG to allow printing at kiosk. Free download required paid for subscription to save the file, paid and quality was awful even in 8x6” size. Immediately uninstalled but a waste of time and money. Just screenshotted the file and quality was far superior.
